title: monitoring.md's receipt paragraph does not say a failed --receipt run or append is retried at the next refresh
goal: The receipt paragraph of kb/_self/monitoring.md says a --receipt run that fails (no output, bad JSON, timeout) or whose append fails is tried again at the next refresh

run: import sys;t=open("kb/_self/monitoring.md",encoding="utf-8").read();i=t.find("**The receipt.**");seg=t[i:i+1800];sys.exit(0 if ("fails" in seg and "next refresh" in seg) else 1)

repro_reason: the defect is a doc paragraph that omits the retry; the pane mod runs only in an interactive session
